'''Nutorium''' was a metal which could be used to make alloys. One such alloy was capable of blocking [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] equipment and was used to make [[Hull/Legends|plating]]. When the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jarafok]] hired the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Debret Nightmoon]] to deliver a sealed [[Cargo pod/Legends|cargo pod]], the pod was coated in nutorium alloy plating, much to Nightmoon's surprise.<ref name="ABGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nutorium first appeared in [[1995]] in the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]] and included two short stories to illustrate some of the ships mentioned. The metal appeared in one of these, titled "What you don't know&hellip;," which gave no information as to what era it was set in.<ref name="ABGTAS" />
